item.title: Dixon man arrested after drugs, weapons found at crash scene
item.description: A man from Dixon was arrested after drugs, guns, and drug paraphernalia were discovered during a vehicle crash investigation in Pulaski County, Missouri.

item.description: SPRINGFIELD, Mo. — The City of Springfield announced the reopening of lanes to two-way traffic on Grant Avenue today, between Grand and Walnut Street. item.title: Last week’s Springfield restaurant health code violations, Dec. 8-12
item.description: Routine inspections of food establishments in Springfield revealed a total of 15 priority violations and 10 nonpriority violations, ranging from improper sanitizer concentrations to food items not being properly labeled or refrigerated.

item.title: Springfield City Council votes to move forward with eminent domain for Hotel of Terror
item.description: The Springfield City Council voted unanimously to proceed with the Renew Jordan Creek project, which includes replacing the North Main Avenue bridge through eminent domain, and the Hotel of Terror has faced a series of actions that appear designed to force its closure.
